author: Minions✨

title: My personal review
body:
This app is one of a kind and we need more apps like this.🩷
I’ve tried other apps but this one comes first by a lot.
Because…
•its free- I never saw the need of any app to make you pay for mere daily organization
• it’s simple to use unlike the other apps where you don’t even know where the main functions are and why each buttons does
• it has a tour where it gives a a step by step guide on whether buttons are and what to need them for 
• it has a cute design and name- very aesthetic for your home page
• it has many useful features like switching from dark mode to light mode, starting the beginning of the week by Sunday which I used because I’m from Saudi Arabia
I appreciate this app an hope that it will continue its “legacy” by staying ✨FREE🥲 and staying useful 
PS: I know this is  a long review but I feel like this app deserves it
AND if the creator of this app wants to know. I heard of it from TikTok when you advertised it.
Keep up the good work!🤗
